background_seams.rationale: The flat background and two corner orbs remain continuous with smooth edges and no decorative seams.

connector_endpoints.rationale: The arrow is clearly visible, begins at the left card boundary, terminates at the right card boundary, and points in the correct direction.

connector_topology.rationale: The single left-to-right relationship from the blue card to the green card matches the source exactly.

crop_boundaries.rationale: No image or SVG crops are present, and the native shapes show no unintended rectangular crop boundary, halo, or clipped content.

key_proportions.rationale: Title block, two cards, connector, footer, and corner orbs retain the source's scale, spacing, and centered balance.

typography_hierarchy.rationale: Title, subtitle, card headings, card body text, and footer preserve the source's size hierarchy, weights, one-line breaks, alignment, and density.

visual_depth.rationale: The source intentionally uses a restrained flat style; fills, borders, and layering are reproduced without flattening any source depth cue.
